notes: Previously exposed source V full-frequency fusion: LoRa low urban 33/60 vs real gain 34/60, WiSig 332/360 vs R17 332/360; both failed fixed per-half thresholds. Clean remained unchanged.

On each current packet, obtain source-trained R17 channel action and variance. Solve identical two-CG weighted MAP for fused estimate and skip anchor; add the difference to the unmodified anchor and apply 5% RMS output cap. Zero learned correction yields the anchor exactly. Same rule is used for source U training and inference.

Motivation: preceding shared fusion computes eight groupwise spectra, while the native LoRa starting point uses 8192-point packet spectrum. Test one shared full-packet spectral rule at native 8192 / 256 lengths; weights trained separately from lawful sources.

Full FFT feature channels are four normalized spectral powers of received, real-gain expert, physical prior and action-adjoint residual, plus each channel global frequency mean; same real convolution predicts two bounded real gains per frequency. No DC correction. Preserve 1% physical-prior cap, 5% skip-anchor correction cap and source teacher loss as bounded groupwise reference.

Motivation from exposed WiSig source V: unbounded prior candidate 321/360 versus R17 332/360 (1 repair, 12 harmed), clean unchanged. LoRa unbounded candidate still training when this candidate was fixed.

Train and infer using the same per-packet last-prior output: original_R17 + min(1, 0.01*RMS(original_R17)/RMS(updated_R17-original_R17))*(updated_R17-original_R17). This 1% limit is on physical prior, separate from the 5% real-gain correction cap; reference R17 remains frozen.

Hypothesis: a trainable final unrolled physical prior can cooperate with shared real-frequency fusion while preserving the parent coarse recovery, channel estimate, first two priors and original checkpoint.

Each dataset uses its own lawful original R17 and own separately trained weights. Source loss: clean teacher KL on fusion + 0.2 clean teacher KL on R17 + 0.2 normalized waveform MSE + 1.5 clean fusion-anchor MSE + 0.5 clean R17-parent MSE. LoRa W24 exact forward / surrogate backward; WiSig default Tri-SIG-TIME teacher.

Source U simulated clean/received only; no U TX truth, source V or target IQ/truth/statistics in training. Same 4096 samples and simulator as urban teacher control, but different batch size and extra trainable prior. Historical LoRa gain teacher ancestry disclosed.

Previously exposed source V selected anchors and influenced design. Fixed IDs, observations, matched controls, half thresholds and clean protection remain unchanged. Independent source replication is required before formal target test.
Extra frozen R17 copy incurs inference and memory cost; trainable model counts alone do not represent full execution cost.
